description: This file defines the NetworkStatusService class which provides asynchronous network status checking functionality for iOS devices. It monitors network path changes, handles timeouts, and constructs payloads representing network state and interfaces.

classes.name: NetworkStatusService
classes.description: A final class that provides network status information via asynchronous API, utilizing NWPathMonitor.

classes.name: NetworkStatusState
classes.description: A utility class managing completion state with thread-safety using NSLock, to coordinate asynchronous network monitoring.

methods.name: currentStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current network status, with an optional timeout parameter; manages network path updates and fallbacks.

methods.name: payload(from:)
methods.description: Creates a network status payload from a given NWPath object, detailing the network status and interface types.

methods.name: fallbackPayload
methods.description: Generates a default network status payload indicating no network connectivity.

methods.name: markCompleted
methods.description: Marks the current network status check as completed in a thread-safe manner, ensuring only one completion occurs.
